name: run-workflow-action
description: Start one of your workflows when a trigger fires, with the inputs you set here. The workflow runs in the background and records its own outcome; the workflow's own overlap policy decides what happens when it is already running.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Inputs
x-meta.help: The workflow's inputs. Required ones are checked when you save.

x-meta.label: Mode
x-meta.help: How the run's gates wait for you. Background, the default and the right choice for a trigger, stops waiting soon and surfaces the question to you; blocking waits as if you were watching the run.

x-meta.label: Project
x-meta.help: Optional project the run belongs to.

x-meta.label: Idempotency Key
x-meta.help: Optional. A retried fire with the same key gets the existing run back instead of starting a second one.

x-meta.label: Dry Run
x-meta.help: Say what a fire would do (start, queue or skip) without starting anything.
